newsitem.title: UK: Moscow domestic loans for'98 seen at $4.3mln - MICEX.
newsitem.headline: Moscow domestic loans for'98 seen at $4.3mln - MICEX.

text.p: The Government of Moscow's domestic loans for 1998 are expected to be 25 billion Roubles ($4.3 million), general director of the Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX) Alexander Zakharov told bankers at a conference on Friday.
"The loans for 1998 in the domestic market are expected to be 25 billion Roubles," he said.
"Moscow government plans to place by the middle of 1997 10 billion Roubles worth of municipal bonds and up to 3.0 billion Roubles worth of Eurobonds,"Zakharov said.
He said the planned issue of GKO-OFZ was permanently over 40 billion Roubles per month in 1997.
Zakharov said foreign investment in Russia was growing.
"The biggest part of the investments come from German companies," he said.
The bulk of investment was in stocks of privatised companies, followed by investment in the ADR and GDR markets.
Investment in Eurobonds came third, but with the largest growth in investment shown.

Zakharov was speaking to investors ahead of the launch of the City of Moscow's debut Eurobond -- an offering of up to $400 million with a three-year maturity -- expected to be launched by the end of May.
